name: Infrared Flame Detector
description: Like fire eyes! Detects the invisible 760nm to 1100nm infrared spectrum radiating from flames.
realWorldAnalogy: Like fire eyes! Detects the invisible 760nm to 1100nm infrared spectrum radiating from flames.

hazards: Sensitive to heat and fire sources
safety.childSafeAlternative: Simulate with an infrared LED or flashlight

wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, D0 (Green) to digital pin 4, and A0 (Yellow) to analog pin A0.
commonMistakes: Bringing an open flame too close to the sensor and melting the epoxy casing.
Testing under direct sunlight, which floods the sensor with ambient infrared light.

miniExperiment.title: Infrared Flame Detector
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, A0 to Analog Pin A0.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Reads high numbers (~900-1023) in normal room light, and drops below 200 when exposed to an infrared source.
